```{python}
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.io as pio
import numpy as np

np.random.seed(42)

pio.renderers.default = "notebook"

# Initialize Spark Session
spark = SparkSession.builder.appName("LightcastData").getOrCreate()

# Load Data
df = spark.read.option("header", "true").option("inferSchema", "true").option("multiLine","true").option("escape", "\"").csv("./data/lightcast_job_postings.csv")

# Show Schema and Sample Data
print("---This is Diagnostic check, No need to print it in the final doc---")

df.printSchema() # comment this line when rendering the submission
df.show(5)
```

```{python}
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, pow
from pyspark.ml.feature import StringIndexer, OneHotEncoder, VectorAssembler
from pyspark.ml import Pipeline

continuous_cols = ["MIN_YEARS_EXPERIENCE", "MAX_YEARS_EXPERIENCE", "SALARY_FROM"]
categorical_cols = ["EMPLOYMENT_TYPE_NAME", "STATE_NAME"]

df = df.dropna(subset=continuous_cols + categorical_cols + ["SALARY"])

indexers = [StringIndexer(inputCol=col, outputCol=col + "_Index") for col in categorical_cols]
encoders = [OneHotEncoder(inputCol=col + "_Index", outputCol=col + "_OHE") for col in categorical_cols]

assembler = VectorAssembler(
    inputCols=continuous_cols + [col + "_OHE" for col in categorical_cols],
    outputCol="features"
)

pipeline = Pipeline(stages=indexers + encoders + [assembler])
data = pipeline.fit(df).transform(df)

data = data.withColumn("MIN_YEARS_EXPERIENCE_SQ", pow(col("MIN_YEARS_EXPERIENCE"), 2))

assembler_poly = VectorAssembler(
    inputCols=continuous_cols + ["MIN_YEARS_EXPERIENCE_SQ"] + [col + "_OHE" for col in categorical_cols],
    outputCol="features_poly"
)
data = assembler_poly.transform(data)

data.select("SALARY", "features", "features_poly").show(5, truncate=False)
```
```{python}
train_data, test_data = data.randomSplit([0.8, 0.2], seed=42)

print((train_data.count(), len(train_data.columns)))
print((test_data.count(), len(test_data.columns)))
```

#KMeans
```{python}
from pyspark.ml.clustering import KMeans
from pyspark.ml.feature import VectorAssembler, StandardScaler
from pyspark.ml import Pipeline

cluster_features = ["MIN_YEARS_EXPERIENCE", "MAX_YEARS_EXPERIENCE", "SALARY_FROM"]
df_cluster = df.dropna(subset=cluster_features)
vec_assembler = VectorAssembler(inputCols=cluster_features, outputCol="raw_features")

scaler = StandardScaler(inputCol="raw_features", outputCol="features", withMean=True, withStd=True)
kmeans = KMeans(featuresCol="features", predictionCol="cluster", k=4, seed=42)
pipeline = Pipeline(stages=[vec_assembler, scaler, kmeans])
model = pipeline.fit(df_cluster)
clustered = model.transform(df_cluster)
clustered.select("MIN_YEARS_EXPERIENCE", "MAX_YEARS_EXPERIENCE", "SALARY_FROM", "cluster").show(10)
```


#linear regression
```{python}
from pyspark.ml.regression import GeneralizedLinearRegression
from pyspark.sql import Row
from pyspark.ml.evaluation import RegressionEvaluator

glr = GeneralizedLinearRegression(
    featuresCol="features",       
    labelCol="SALARY",
    family="gaussian",
    link="identity",
    maxIter=10,
    regParam=0.3
)

glr_model = glr.fit(train_data)
summary = glr_model.summary


feature_names = summary._call_java("featureNames")

features = ["Intercept"] + feature_names
coefs = [float(glr_model.intercept)] + [float(x) for x in glr_model.coefficients]
se = [float(summary.coefficientStandardErrors[0])] + [float(x) for x in summary.coefficientStandardErrors[1:]]
tvals = [float(summary.tValues[0])] + [float(x) for x in summary.tValues[1:]]
pvals = [float(summary.pValues[0])] + [float(x) for x in summary.pValues[1:]]


print("---This is Diagnostic check, No need to print it in the final doc---")
print("Length of features:", len(features))
print("Length of coefs:", len(coefs))
print("Length of se:", len(se))
print("Length of tvals:", len(tvals))
print("Length of pvals:", len(pvals))

rows = [
    Row(
        Feature=str(f),
        Coef=float(c),
        StdErr=float(s),
        tValue=float(t),
        pValue=float(p)
    ) for f, c, s, t, p in zip(features, coefs, se, tvals, pvals)
]

result_df = spark.createDataFrame(rows)
result_df.show(truncate=False)

predictions = glr_model.transform(test_data)

evaluator_r2 = RegressionEvaluator(labelCol="SALARY", predictionCol="prediction", metricName="r2")
evaluator_rmse = RegressionEvaluator(labelCol="SALARY", predictionCol="prediction", metricName="rmse")
evaluator_mae = RegressionEvaluator(labelCol="SALARY", predictionCol="prediction", metricName="mae")

r2 = evaluator_r2.evaluate(predictions)
rmse = evaluator_rmse.evaluate(predictions)
mae = evaluator_mae.evaluate(predictions)

print(f"R²: {r2:.4f}")
print(f"RMSE: {rmse:.2f}")
print(f"MAE: {mae:.2f}")
```

#Polymnomial Regression
```{python}

from pyspark.ml.regression import GeneralizedLinearRegression
from pyspark.sql import Row
from pyspark.ml.evaluation import RegressionEvaluator


poly_lr = GeneralizedLinearRegression(
    featuresCol="features_poly",
    labelCol="SALARY",
    family="gaussian",
    link="identity",
    maxIter=10,
    regParam=0.3
)

poly_model = poly_lr.fit(train_data)
poly_preds = poly_model.transform(test_data)
summary = poly_model.summary


feature_names = summary._call_java("featureNames")

poly_features = ["Intercept"] + feature_names
poly_coefs = [float(poly_model.intercept)] + [float(x) for x in poly_model.coefficients]
poly_se = [float(summary.coefficientStandardErrors[0])] + [float(x) for x in summary.coefficientStandardErrors[1:]]
poly_tvals = [float(summary.tValues[0])] + [float(x) for x in summary.tValues[1:]]
poly_pvals = [float(summary.pValues[0])] + [float(x) for x in summary.pValues[1:]]


print("---This is Diagnostic check, No need to print it in the final doc---")
print("Length of features:", len(poly_features))
print("Length of coefs:", len(poly_coefs))
print("Length of se:", len(poly_se))
print("Length of tvals:", len(poly_tvals))
print("Length of pvals:", len(poly_pvals))


rows = [
    Row(
        Feature=str(f),
        Coef=float(c),
        StdErr=float(s),
        tValue=float(t),
        pValue=float(p)
    ) for f, c, s, t, p in zip(poly_features, poly_coefs, poly_se, poly_tvals, poly_pvals)
]

poly_result_df = spark.createDataFrame(rows)
poly_result_df.show(truncate=False)


evaluator_r2 = RegressionEvaluator(labelCol="SALARY", predictionCol="prediction", metricName="r2")
evaluator_rmse = RegressionEvaluator(labelCol="SALARY", predictionCol="prediction", metricName="rmse")
evaluator_mae = RegressionEvaluator(labelCol="SALARY", predictionCol="prediction", metricName="mae")

r2 = evaluator_r2.evaluate(poly_preds)
rmse = evaluator_rmse.evaluate(poly_preds)
mae = evaluator_mae.evaluate(poly_preds)

print(f"Polynomial Model - R²: {r2:.4f}")
print(f"Polynomial Model - RMSE: {rmse:.2f}")
print(f"Polynomial Model - MAE: {mae:.2f}")
```

#Random Forest Regressor
```{python}
from pyspark.ml.regression import RandomForestRegressor
from pyspark.ml.evaluation import RegressionEvaluator

rf = RandomForestRegressor(
    featuresCol="features",         
    numTrees=200,                  
    maxDepth=6,                     
    seed=42
)

rf_model = rf.fit(train_data.select("SALARY", "features"))

rf_preds = rf_model.transform(test_data)

evaluator_r2 = RegressionEvaluator(labelCol="SALARY", predictionCol="prediction", metricName="r2")
evaluator_rmse = RegressionEvaluator(labelCol="SALARY", predictionCol="prediction", metricName="rmse")
evaluator_mae = RegressionEvaluator(labelCol="SALARY", predictionCol="prediction", metricName="mae")

r2 = evaluator_r2.evaluate(rf_preds)
rmse = evaluator_rmse.evaluate(rf_preds)
mae = evaluator_mae.evaluate(rf_preds)

print(f"Random Forest Model - R²: {r2:.4f}")
print(f"Random Forest Model - RMSE: {rmse:.2f}")
print(f"Random Forest Model - MAE: {mae:.2f}")
```
